responsibility: Implements RISC-V psABI lowering for `FnAbi`, including floating-point aggregate eligibility analysis, XLEN/FLEN-based scalar and aggregate register classification, sign-extension behavior, varargs alignment rules, and tracking available integer and floating-point argument registers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/riscv.rs`, this RISC-V file implements psABI call lowering with FP-convention eligibility, XLEN/FLEN-based assignment, varargs alignment, and GPR/FPR tracking, instead of defining inline-assembly registers and feature-gated availability like `e`-mode exclusions.
